verdicts.reasoning: The samples require an actual computation to resolve, not a fact recall: seed 64 needs 30 - 6 = 24, seed 118 needs 45 - 2 = 43, and seed 11 needs the pupil to compute 90 - 43 themselves in order to judge whether Rosa's 47 is right.

Nothing in any of the ten samples is presented by voice — every stem is written text the pupil reads, and even the quoted problems at seeds 11 and 127 are printed inside quotation marks rather than spoken. No audio payload or 'listen' instruction appears anywhere in the set.
verdicts.action_taken: Filed as a §6F CONTRADICTED finding, unedited. Fifth independent blind refusal of an 'orally' clause in the tree. Written text channel cannot exhibit oral delivery; tracked as part of the oral/audio delivery capability class under Rule 8.

verdicts.reasoning: Seed 103 is the one item that draws anything: an EmojiPictorial of chicks with group_a 40 and group_b 2 for the take-away, so the subtraction is at least partly presented as a picture. It is a single sample out of ten, and the picture is not load-bearing.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: The seed 103 payload renders the group as the text label '(Large group of 40 chicks)' rather than 40 countable chicks, and the stem already states both 40 and 2, so the pupil never needs to read the picture. The stem line 'Taking away 2 chicks.' is also ungrammatical for a Grade 2 reader.

verdicts.reasoning: Subtraction is the operation in all ten samples, in several guises: take-away (90 - 43 at seed 11), removal (21 - 2 at seed 23, keyed to correct_value 19), reduction of a set (30 - 6 at seed 64) and count-back on the number sequence (50 - 30 at seed 57).
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Seeds 91 and 127 subtract zero ('goes down 0 steps', 'Count back 0'). They are arithmetically valid but degenerate as subtraction practice, and two of ten samples spent on them is a lot.

verdicts.reasoning: Both operands stay two-digit or smaller throughout, and the set pushes near the ceiling without breaching it: 90 - 43 at seed 11, 50 - 30 at seed 57 and 45 - 2 at seed 118, with no minuend above 90 anywhere in the ten.

Both regrouping cases are present. Seeds 11 (90 - 43) and 23 (21 - 2) force a borrow because the ones digit of the minuend is smaller than the subtrahend's, whereas seeds 118 (45 - 2) and 57 (50 - 30) resolve digit-by-digit with no exchange.
